digest.component_or_area: pytest fixture teardown for snapshot tests
propositions: pytest basetemp cleanup on macOS fails with PermissionError when snapshot-producing tests leave read-only .rebar/run_snapshots directories, because the cleanup fixture was module-local only
production snapshots intentionally apply 0444/0555 permissions via _chmod_readonly, and snapshot._rmtree_writable correctly removes such read-only residual trees
snapshot producers in any module outside test_snapshot.py bypass the module-local cleanup fixture and leave non-removable .rebar/run_snapshots roots below shared pytest tmp_path

shared pytest teardown in tests/conftest.py must search for and remove exact .rebar/run_snapshots roots below test-owned tmp_path using snapshot._rmtree_writable, while leaving adjacent temp content untouched
